Elaine Park: Quick heads-up — drafting release notes for the upcoming docs push (adaptive batching + SDK 1.4 changes). Need someone to own: SDK snippets sweep, migration guide, and link fixes.
Matt G.: I can do SDK snippets. Which repos? python, js, go?
Elaine Park: python + js primarily. Go only if time. Main changes: client.call signature now accepts timeout_ms and streaming flag. Snippet example to update:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.call('gpt-4-mini', prompt='...')
```
should become
```
resp = c.call('gpt-4-mini', prompt='...', timeout_ms=20000, stream=False)
```
Samir: I'll open a quick PR for the migration guide and add a "Known issues" note about streaming + partial-embeddings. ETA EOD.
Olivia: FYI there's a redirect broken on /docs/embeddings/streaming -> /docs/embeddings? It 404s. I'll push linkfix PR but need QA on preview.
docs-bot: Checklist: [ ] relnotes draft in /docs/releases, [ ] snippets updated, [ ] migration guide linked, [ ] preview passes linkcheck.
Matt G.: I'll run linkcheck locally before PR. Any specific examples to prioritize? small sample for batch vs stream?
Elaine Park: Prioritize: 1) quickstart python sample, 2) chat streaming example, 3) embeddings snippet. If you hit ambiguous output, add a short note near the snippet.
Samir: PR #452 opened: migration-guide + known-issues. Added placeholder for the changelog bullet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452
